title: Supply of Office Furniture to District Office

exemptions.condition_text: Micro and Small Enterprises registered under Udyam are exempted from payment of EMD, on submission of a valid Udyam registration certificate.

requirements.description: Average annual turnover of not less than Rs. 5 Crore during the last three financial years

exemptions.condition_text: Micro and Small Enterprises registered under Udyam are exempted from the turnover requirement in clause 2.1, on submission of a valid Udyam registration certificate.

requirements.source_quote:
2.1 The bidder must have an average annual turnover of not less than
Rs. 5 Crore during the last three financial years.
2.2 The bidder must have a valid GST registration.
2.3 The bidder must hold a valid ISO 9001 certification.

requirements.description: Successfully completed at least one similar supply order of value not less than Rs. 20 lakh in the last five years
requirements.source_quote:
2.4 The bidder must have successfully completed at least one similar
supply order of value not less than Rs. 20 lakh in the last five years.

requirements.description: Performance security of 5% of contract value
requirements.source_quote:
4.1 The successful bidder shall furnish a performance security of
5% of the contract value.
